name: Worgen in the Woods
summary: Calor sends you to Darkshire with a letter for Jonathan Carevin after your hunts against the worgen in Duskwood. Carevin faces dangers beyond the beasts, and Calor believes your skill can aid him.

sections.title: A Rare Recommendation
sections.body: You have driven the Nightbane pack from Roland's Doom and the shadowed glades, earning Calor's respect. He is stationed on the dark frontier of the woods and rarely offers praise or formal introductions. Calor gives you a faded scrap of parchment and asks you to deliver his recommendation to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire. He says that with more fighters like you, his small company might outshine the town's beleaguered Night Watch.

sections.title: Carevin's Vigil
sections.body: Jonathan Carevin works in Darkshire under heavy strain, wary of outsiders and short on time. The town faces worgen, restless undead, demonic forces, and cultists aiding the corruption from within. Calor's recommendation wins Carevin's trust, and he sees you as a dependable fighter ready to preserve the Light against Duskwood's terrors.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
faq.answer: Calor sends you to deliver a faded letter of recommendation to Jonathan Carevin. Your success against the worgen packs across Duskwood has earned Calor's respect.

Jonathan Carevin is a focused resident of Darkshire who coordinates the town's defense against supernatural threats. Though wary of strangers, he works with trusted allies such as Calor against undead, demons, and those who aid them.

faq.q: Why is Calor so dismissive of the Night Watch?
faq.answer: Calor believes the Night Watch is struggling to meet the many dangers in Duskwood. He thinks a few capable fighters can do more against them than the town's small company can manage.

faq.q: What threats does Carevin warn about upon delivery?
faq.answer: Carevin faces worgen, restless undead, demonic forces, and cultists who help the corruption from within. The town is under pressure from threats on every side.

faq.q: Does this quest require any combat?
faq.answer: No. You only need to take Calor's letter to Carevin in Darkshire. The earlier hunts against the Nightbane worgen are already behind you.

faq.q: Where can I find Jonathan Carevin?
faq.answer: Jonathan Carevin is in Darkshire, where he attends to the town's defense.

angles.text: With the Kingdom of Stormwind failing to spare soldiers for Duskwood's borderlands, independent Alliance adventurers and vigilantes like Carevin are the town's only line of defense.
As a paladin, Carevin welcomes proven allies with words of the Holy Light and seeks holy champions to face Duskwood's unholy evils.
As a priest, you hear Carevin's parting blessing, “Glory under the Light,” a sign of the defenders' faith amid Darkshire's unending corruption.
